summary_short: Krishna reveals divine knowledge, the secret of incarnation, and how wisdom transforms action into liberation.
summary_medium: Krishna explains that this eternal knowledge was passed through generations and is now revealed again to Arjuna. He describes the purpose of divine incarnation, the nature of true action, and how knowledge burns all karma.
summary_detailed: Krishna reveals that the Gita’s wisdom is eternal and was taught to ancient sages.
He explains the divine mystery of incarnation (avatar).
Krishna appears whenever righteousness declines and adharma rises.
The chapter clarifies the paradox of action and inaction.
True knowledge removes attachment and purifies action.
Different paths of sacrifice are explained.
Wisdom is declared the highest purifier.
Knowledge leads directly to peace and liberation.
what_you_learn: The eternal nature of divine knowledge.
Why knowledge frees one from karma.
Why faith is essential for realization.
